case.summary:
Investigation confirmed unauthorized activity on card C07987-K2 under pattern 'card_not_present_new_device'. Total exposure identified is $99.92 across 1 transaction(s). Cardholder outreach and graph evidence confirmed compromise; defensive card blocks and case progression executed.

Decision Sensitivity (Counterfactual Boundaries):
  1. [Cardholder Confirmation]: Customer confirms authorization during SMS or mobile push challenge -> Fraud probability would reduce from 1.00 to ≤ 0.10, flipping verdict to LEGITIMATE (Rule R3).
  2. [Device Fingerprint Baseline]: Device had ≥2 prior authorized transactions in cardholder history -> Eliminates new-device risk penalty (-15.0 pts), preventing automated card block.
  3. [Billing Region Proximity]: Transaction billing region aligned with baseline regions (448.0, 184.0) -> Eliminates geographic distance anomaly penalty (-20.0 pts) and impossible travel flag.
  4. [Device Exclusivity]: Device profile observed solely on this customer account -> Removes syndicate sharing flag (5 linked cards), downgrading from SAR requirement.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-01 and 2016-12-01, cardholder C07987 experienced unauthorized activity on card C07987-K2. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $99.92 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_new_device'. The primary flagged transaction 3503878 ($99.92) was initiated through the online channel. Activity originated from a device profile (Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720) marked as New for this account. The same device profile was also observed across 5 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C07987-K2 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.
